subject: ui/verbosity
statement: Human CLI verbosity is a presentation policy, not a workflow/data contract: project config ui.verbosity supports compact|verbose, defaults fail-soft to compact, and machine-readable --json output remains full regardless of verbosity.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Add configurable compact/verbose human output without changing machine-readable JSON contracts
